acceptanceCriteria: A focused test binds a branch that merges a sealed CEM from another lane with the original BASE.
body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: dogfood-change refuses with sealed-cem-in-change when the branch merges another lane's sealed CEM, except by moving BASE to the merge commit.

Expected: dogfood-change binds such a branch without moving BASE, or names a supported recovery.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: DCW-V0-042 dogfood tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: dogfood-change cannot bind a branch that merges another lane's sealed CEM (sealed-cem-in-change)
